subject: OKR health snapshot + dependency action items (June check)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@nimbus.ai>, procurement@nimbus.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: OKR health snapshot + dependency action items (June check)

Team — attaching the mid-quarter snapshot and the dependency matrix (also link below). High level: two of our Product & Serving OKRs are lagging trajectory vs. plan and need rapid re-scope or extra headroom. I summarized below and called out owners for immediate asks. Please read and respond with ETA or blocking risks by EOD today.

Quick summary (see attached PDF for charts):
- Serving runtime latency SLO (Objective: P95 < 180ms) — currently sitting at 210ms for critical workloads; main drivers are long-tail batches on legacy kernel path. Owner: Markus.
- Private deployment adoption (Objective: 12 private customers onboarded) — 5 onboarded, 2 at procurement/legal step. We are at risk of missing the goal given uptake lag. Owner: Evelyn + CS.
- Cost optimization (Objective: reduce token unit cost by 18%) — on track but several accounts (incl. Nimbus) need tailored batching configs to preserve UX. Owner: Grace.

Immediate asks (owners and why):
1) Markus — provide a short plan to remove the 2s cold-start regressions and timeline for kernel switch; we need canary out by Jul 14. If you need an extra week of infra support, flag it now. (Attachment: dependency_matrix.csv)
2) Evelyn — escalate Nimbus PO/procurement hold-up; loop in legal or provide alternate next steps. Elaine, copied, can you confirm procurement timeline?
3) Grace — share targeted batching/quantization config per Nimbus test case; we need a validated config by next Thu for their pilot.
4) Vivek — exec-level note: if we need to bump hiring or contractor budget to hit the serving work, confirm numbers by end of week so I can surface to Gina.

Notes on communication: I will do a 20-minute sync at 11:30 PT if we have at least two owners able to share progress. If not, send updates in this thread and I will collate for the Friday leadership review.

Attachments: 2026-06-30_OKR_health_dashboard.pdf, 2026-06-30_dependency_matrix.csv

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@nimbus.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OKR health snapshot + dependency action items (June check)

Laura — thanks for the clear callouts. Quick update:
- Root cause for the P95 regressions is twofold: (1) fallback kernel path for specific attention patterns on older models, and (2) batch alignment issues when prefix caching misses occur.
- Immediate mitigations (this week): increase short-burst capacity on the optimized kernel and roll a micro-patch to reduce kernel fallback frequency. We expect a 12–15% improvement for affected workloads.

Plan and timeline:
- Today: finalize patch and run internal perfbench.
- 7/2: canary rollout to <2% traffic (dev-only models).
- 7/8: broader canary to staging + partner test (Grace to sync for Nimbus traffic).
- 7/14: target full rollout conditional on partner sign-offs.

Blockers: I will need two additional GPU nodes in the west region for the 7/8 staging run — estimated cost impact ~ $8k for the test window. If procurement/ops can provision these, we stay on schedule.

-Markus
Engineering Director, Serving Runtime

Laura / team — quick procurement status for Nimbus:
- Nimbus legal sign-off completed last week; procurement now needs an internal PO and billing details. Elaine, our contact, said procurement is waiting for a vendor risk re-check and final PO approval from their finance team.
- I opened a support ticket with our finance ops to expedite the vendor risk artifact (SOC2 summary + current audit link). Finance ops says they can issue a 'vendor summary pack' by 7/2 if legal confirms the list of artifacts.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) I'll ask Legal to push the artifact list today and run the vendor summary pack by 7/2.
2) If Nimbus requires a PO template, attaching a draft (Nimbus_PO_template.docx) — Elaine, can you confirm if this aligns with your procurement team?
3) If the PO lane is sticky after 7/3, we should consider a short-term pilot agreement (30-day) with a capped spend to unblock their pilot.

I'll update by EOD with confirmation or next steps.

—Evelyn
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — Grace here with the batching plan for Nimbus pilot. Short version: we can preserve UX while reducing token cost by ~14% using two levers: adaptive prefix caching and a conservative quantization profile for their LLM instance. Detailed notes attached.

Next steps for Nimbus pilot:
- 7/1: handoff test config (staging) — I will upload config and run a smoke test.
- 7/8: run joint partner test during Markus's canary window (we should limit traffic to their pilot users only).
- 7/10: consolidation and metric review, then sign-off for wider rollout.

Attachment: (internal) batching_config_nimbus_v1.json (uploaded to drive link). Elaine — if you can confirm a small test cohort (10–20 users) and expected test dates, I will schedule the test run.

—Grace
Principal Product Manager, Cost & Efficiency
Redwood Inference

Laura — noted. Budget/hiring impact:
- I ran a quick forecast: to accelerate the serving runtime work we can either (A) reassign two SRE contractors (~$45k/month) for the July window and absorb into Q3 ops contingency, or (B) open one full-time senior infra hire (timeline 8–10 weeks) which would push completion later but gives long-term runway.
- Recommendation: use contractors for the short-term push to meet the 7/14 rollout and revisit headcount in next hiring cycle.

I'll confirm the contractor vendor/estimate by EOD and flag if exec approval is required.

—Vivek
VP, Infrastructure

- Markus: approved for two GPU nodes for the test window. I'll coordinate with Ops and cc Gina for budget acknowledgment. Please attach an ops ticket number when you open it.
- Evelyn: please proceed with vendor summary pack and confirm whether the short pilot agreement is acceptable to Nimbus if PO delays persist. Evelyn, copy any legal folks here.
